subject: Security gating & retention alignment for MAP — Clearwater Finance
messages:
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
To: ellie.harper@clearwater-fin.com, tim.cho@clearwater-fin.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Security gating & retention alignment for MAP — Clearwater Finance

Hi Ellie / Tim —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a short MAP-focused checklist so we can lock the remaining security/compliance gates and final close timeline. Attaching a working spreadsheet (Clearwater_MAP_v2.xlsx) with proposed owners and target dates. High-level asks: 

- Confirm which acceptance artifacts Clearwater requires for SOC 2 (report copy, auditor attestation, or self-reporting summary).
- Confirm SIG/CAIQ depth — do you need the full questionnaire answered or just control references?
- DPA: your legal team flagged two clauses; I attached our redlines (DPA_redlines_20280319.pdf). Can Morgan Legal and your GC confirm any mandatory language?
- Data retention and residency: you mentioned EU customer residency as a blocker for one product flow; can you confirm which datasets must remain in-region and the retention windows (e.g., 30/90/365 days)?

Proposed milestone: evidence delivery for SOC 2 + SIG references by 2028-03-30, final DPA signoff by 2028-04-07, and go/no-go decision the week of 2028-04-10. If that aligns, we’ll convert the sheet into a mutual action plan and assign deadlines in HubSpot.

Next steps: please review the attached MAP sheet, indicate owner columns, and add any other gating items. Kim (cc’d) will take point on evidence intake and orchestration.

Thanks —
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Clearwater_MAP_v2.xlsx, DPA_redlines_20280319.pdf

From: ellie.harper@clearwater-fin.com
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: tim.cho@clearwater-fin.com, morgan.legal@clearwater-fin.com
Date: 2028-03-20T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security gating & retention alignment for MAP — Clearwater Finance

Diego —

Appreciate the clear ask list. Quick answers inline below and a few clarifying questions: 

- SOC 2: we require a Type II report from the last 12 months and the auditor attestation PDF. A self-report is not sufficient for this engagement.
- SIG/CAIQ: we only need the CAIQ control map for Level 1 (data access, encryption, incident response). Full SIG questionnaire is optional — we can start with CAIQ references.
- DPA: Morgan Legal will review your redlines. We have a mandatory clause about cross-border transfers for EU-origin data — please confirm if Redwood supports customer-controlled residency or if the hosted product stores backups in a separate region.
- Retention: for EU accounts we need a 90-day retention max for transaction logs and 365 days for anonymized analytics. Personally identifiable data (PII) should be retained no longer than 30 days unless otherwise agreed.

We’ll review the MAP spreadsheet today and populate the owner column. Can we ask Kim to map where evidence will be staged (S3 vs shared drive) and whether you support an audit connector for direct auditor access?

Thanks,
Ellie Harper
Head of Integrations, Clearwater Finance

Attachments: (none)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: ellie.harper@clearwater-fin.com, diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-21T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security gating & retention alignment for MAP — Clearwater Finance

Ellie / Diego —

Thanks — Kim here. Short answers and action items from the runtime/ops side: 

- Residency: Redwood Private (VPC) supports customer-controlled region pinning for models and KV caches. Hosted backups are normally multi-region but for regulated customers we can enable region-scoped backups or an on-prem package. I’ll capture the config options on the MAP sheet.
- Audit access: we provide a time-limited read-only S3 artifact export for auditor intake, or we can spin up a temporary read-only environment for an auditor to run verification. Which would be preferred by your auditor?
- Evidence staging: plan to use secure S3 bucket with access logs; we’ll provide signed URLs for each artifact and a manifest CSV.

Action: I’ll update the spreadsheet with evidence owners, staging location, and the two exchange options (auditor export vs temporary audit env). I’ll aim to have that by EOD 2028-03-22.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Operations, Redwood Inference

From: morgan.legal@clearwater-fin.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: ellie.harper@clearwater-fin.com
Date: 2028-03-25T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security gating & retention alignment for MAP — Clearwater Finance

Hi all —

Morgan Legal here on behalf of Clearwater. We reviewed the redlines and have two substantive asks: 

1) Cross-border transfers: Clearwater requires contractual confirmation that EU customer data (as defined in §2.1 of the DPA) will not be transferred outside the EU unless (a) explicit customer consent is obtained, or (b) adequate safeguards (SCCs or equivalent) are in place. Please confirm Redwood’s standard approach and whether you can accept language referencing SCCs.

2) Subprocessor list and notification cadence: we need an explicit subprocessor list and a 30-day prior notice for new subprocessors affecting EU data. If Redwood cannot provide a full list now, please confirm a cadence for disclosure and a process for customer objection.

We can accept a staging approach for SOC 2 artifacts (attestation + report) delivered by 2028-03-30 if the above DPA points are addressed in the next redline pass.

Regards,
Morgan Legal
Morgan & Lee LLP

Attachment: redline_comments_morgan_20280325.pdf

From: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
To: ellie.harper@clearwater-fin.com, tim.cho@clearwater-fin.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, morgan.legal@clearwater-fin.com
Date: 2028-03-28T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security gating & retention alignment for MAP — Clearwater Finance

Team —

Thanks for the rapid review and the DPA guidance. Quick update and commitments so we can finalize the MAP and close timeline: 

- DPA: Legal (Marissa) will take lead on a responsive redline. Redwood accepts SCCs for EU transfers; we will produce a DPA redline that includes SCC reference and propose a 30-day notification for subprocessors. Expect the redline by 2028-04-01.
- SOC 2: we will provide the Type II auditor report and attestation by 2028-03-30 to your secure staging bucket. Kim will share the signed URL manifest when complete.
- CAIQ: we will deliver the CAIQ control map for Level 1 by 2028-03-27 (in progress).
- Retention: confirming we can enforce a 90-day retention for transaction logs (EU) and 30-day max for PII; Neha will document retention enforcement paths and flag any features requiring a design change by 2028-04-05.

Next steps: I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet into the mutual action plan version and send a HubSpot link. If Morgan Legal has any additional mandatory language, please send redlines directly to marissa.cole@redwood.ai.

Thanks —
Diego
